name: Tales of Seikyu
description:
Welcome to your enchanting new life in a magical world of wonder and adventure!

Seikyu — an island haven hidden far from the human world — is a sanctuary full of Yokai residents who can freely express themselves in human form. Settle down in your homeland, help expand the town, and uncover the secrets of this island and your long-lost family!

Game Features

📖 Enjoy a heart-warming tale of family, friendship and love.

💖 Find your soulmate with a broad selection of romancable NPCs!

🌱 Farm, fish, mine, craft, cook and level up your skills!

👹 Use your magical Yokai powers to farm, fight, and explore!

🍂 Experience the turning of the seasons and take part in various festivals and quests!

🏡 Meet the locals, get to know them, and give them gifts!

💎 Delve into hidden ruins, find treasures, and uncover the secrets of the island...

🦊 ...and much more!

You’ll have plenty of love interests to choose from in Seikyu, each with their own unique personalities and heart-warming stories. It’s up to you to get to know the villagers by completing heart events: special quests that help relationships blossom and guide you towards your perfect match.

Experience heart events with six of our eligible bachelors and bachelorettes at our Early Access launch, with even more heart events (and characters!) coming throughout our Early Access journey.

Using your Fox Clan heritage, shapeshift into magical Yokai forms to take care of your homestead and explore the world! Soar freely in the skies of Seikyu as the Crow Tengu, dive deep for sunken treasure as a slime, or till the ground of your farm as a boar. You’ll unlock even more Yokai forms on your journey!

Cultivate crops, craft furniture, and cook meals from locally sourced ingredients. Decorate your ancestral inn to reflect your unique vision - whether you're a fan of the cozy cottage aesthetic or traditional Eastern vibes, the choice is yours!

The Seikyu ranch will also be opening soon in a future content update! Raise livestock and collect ingredients to expand your resources!

Experience the land’s seasonal changes, help the townsfolk with quests, and take part in various festivals and mini-games! You’ll soon feel part of this magical community.
